name: Diagram connector
visual_intent: Cards, nodes or labels get joined by a curved arrow that draws from one to the other, making a relationship or a hand-off explicit in a diagram.
implementation_summary: Measures both elements as they render at the cue (Studio.boxAt), leaves from the facing edges along the dominant axis with a cubic curve, draws it with stroke-draw and adds a two-stroke arrowhead; dashed connectors fade in instead (dash pattern and dash draw would conflict).
runtime_api: Studio.draw.connect(tl, Studio.draw.layer(scene), a, b, at, {axis, bend, gap, arrow, dashed, className, duration})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (endpoints on the facing edges, fully drawn at the end) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
